issue_codes.description: Deposit rate stated without being expressed as an annual percentage yield, or another rate stated more conspicuously than the APY.
APY stated but one or more required additional disclosures missing (variable rate, as-of date, minimum balance, minimum opening deposit, fees may reduce earnings, CD term, early withdrawal penalty).
Account described as 'free' or 'no cost' when a maintenance or activity fee may be imposed.
Bonus advertised without required terms (time requirement, minimum balance, when the bonus is provided, etc.).
Credit rate stated without the APR, or the APR is less prominent than another rate.
Triggering term used (payment amount, repayment period, down payment, finance charge) without the required additional disclosures.
Promotional/introductory rate not labeled 'introductory'/'intro', or missing its duration or the APR that applies afterward.
Deposit product ad missing the official advertising statement ('Member FDIC').
Non-deposit product presented in a way that represents or implies FDIC insurance, including misuse of the FDIC name or logo.

issue_codes.regulation: Interagency Statement on Retail Sales of Nondeposit Investment Products; FINRA Rule 2210
issue_codes.description: Investment/annuity ad missing 'Not FDIC Insured / Not Bank Guaranteed / May Lose Value' disclosures.
Residential real estate-related loan ad missing the Equal Housing Lender logo or legend.
Wording, imagery or targeting that could discourage applicants on a prohibited basis.
Deceptive or unsubstantiated claim, or fine print that contradicts the headline or net impression.
Prescreened credit offer missing the short-form and/or long-form opt-out notice.
Commercial email missing an unsubscribe mechanism, a valid physical postal address, or other required element, or uses a deceptive subject line.
